The '''Tosarvi'''<ref name="TAVG" /> were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. [[Sarria]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Destiny" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[species]] was distinguished by the six long<ref name="Destiny" /> [[lekku]]<ref name="TAVG" /> that extend down from their heads.<ref name="Destiny" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[148 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}} "[[Destiny (The Acolyte)|Destiny]]" states that the events of the four Jedi ([[Indara]], [[Kelnacca]], [[Sol]], and [[Torbin]]) stationed on the [[planet]] [[Brendok]] and [[Mae-ho Aniseya]]'s burning of the [[Brendok coven]] takes place sixteen years prior to the events of the show, placing all subsequent events of this episode in [[148 BBY]].</ref> a member of this species, [[Sarria]],<ref name="Destiny" /> served as a [[scout]] and [[warrior]]<ref name="Destiny AD">{{Acolyte|Destiny (The Acolyte)}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> for an exiled [[Brendok coven|coven]] of [[witch]]es that lived in<ref name="Destiny" /> an all-[[Gender|female]] community<ref name="Destiny AD" /> in a [[Brendok fortress|fortress]] on the [[planet]] [[Brendok]].<ref name="Destiny" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Kura-X3-Version-1A.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Kura X3 Version 1A by Luke Fisher]]
The Tosarvi made their debut in the [[Destiny (The Acolyte)|third episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Kogonada]].<ref name="Destiny" /> They were originally designed by concept artist [[Luke Fisher]] as a rejected potential design for [[Qi'ra]] in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo Art">''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> Their name was revealed within the ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''<ref name="TAVG" /> which released in select countries on [[June 5]], [[2025]].<ref name="DK UK">{{DK|url=uk/book/9780241710425-star-wars-the-acolyte-visual-guide|text=Star Wars The Acolyte Visual Guide}}</ref>
